notes: Fixes V11.8 lower-controls accessibility on small Raspberry Pi displays.
Keeps the calculator header fixed and makes the full calculator body vertically scrollable with the mouse wheel.
Wheel over the DR grid map continues to zoom the map; wheel elsewhere scrolls the calculator page.
Preserves the stable V11.6/V11.8 layout proportions and prevents the central map from collapsing.
Keeps compact DRP SHOW ON MAP and GNSS SHOW ON MAP buttons.
DRP algorithm and dynamic 500 m grid logic are unchanged from V11.6.
